class.name: FlowPort
class.brief_description: A named input or output of a [FlowNode].
class.description: A [FlowPort] describes one connection point of a [FlowNode]. There are two kinds ([enum PortKind]). A [b]flow[/b] port ([constant PORT_KIND_FLOW]) carries the execution from one node to the next. A [b]data[/b] port ([constant PORT_KIND_DATA]) carries a value and has a [member type] and a [member default_value]. Ports are returned by [method FlowNode.get_input_ports] and [method FlowNode.get_output_ports] and are created in code with [method create_flow] and [method create_data]. Ports are addressed by their [member name], which is unique among the inputs and unique among the outputs of one node. The built-in nodes use the names [code]in[/code] and [code]out[/code] for their flow ports. A data output can be connected to a data input if the types are equal, if either side has the type [constant @GlobalScope.TYPE_NIL] (any type), or if an [int] output goes into a [float] input. A flow port can only be connected to a flow port. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var port := FlowPort.create_data("amount", TYPE_INT, 1, "Amount") print(port.kind == FlowPort.PORT_KIND_DATA) # true [/gdscript] [csharp] FlowPort port = FlowPort.CreateData("amount", Variant.Type.Int, 1, "Amount"); GD.Print(port.Kind == FlowPort.PortKind.Data); // True [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: create_data
method.description: Creates a data port named [param name] that carries values of [param type]. Use [constant @GlobalScope.TYPE_NIL] for a port that accepts any type. [param default_value] is the value an unconnected input uses. [param label] is shown in the graph editor instead of the name when it is not empty.

method.name: create_flow
method.description: Creates a flow port named [param name]. [param label] is shown in the graph editor instead of the name when it is not empty.

members.member: The class of the values when [member type] is [constant @GlobalScope.TYPE_OBJECT], for example [Texture2D]. Only a hint for editors; connections are not checked against it.
The value of a data input that has no connection. Ignored by flow ports.
Whether the port carries the execution (flow) or a value (data). See [enum PortKind].
Text shown in the graph editor instead of [member name]. If empty, the name is shown.
The name of the port, used in [method FlowGraph.connect_nodes] and in saved connections. It must be unique among the inputs, and among the outputs, of one node.
The [enum Variant.Type] of the values of a data port. [constant @GlobalScope.TYPE_NIL] means any type. Ignored by flow ports.

constants.constant: Represents the size of the [enum PortKind] enum.
